_comment: Manual data overlay for models not yet indexed by Artificial Analysis (e.g. brand-new releases). Front-end merges these into live AA data; once AA includes the model (matched by slug keyword), AA values win. Values below are calibrated against AA-reported scores of peers (Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol) using officially published benchmark deltas.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Max
models.calibrationNote: 估算基准:PaperBench 93.0 > Claude Fable 5 (88.8) 与 GPT-5.6 Sol (90.5);GPQA 92.6;OSWorld-Verified 86.1 领先;CoWorkBench 74.8 ≈ Fable 5 (75.9);Terminal-Bench-2.1 86.6(官方发布图,优于 Opus4.8 74.5 / Fable5 84.6 / Gemini3.1-Pro 84.6,略低于 GPT-5.6 Sol 88.8)。三维(Intelligence/Coding/Agentic)基于同级对标估算,Terminal 来自官方图。
